decision_reason: The Ruby profile, tool-state doctor, .rb inventory, dependency-free native fixture, and frozen lexical/semantic/mutation contracts prove a safe foundation, not any completed skill outcome. All 22 jobs remain pending implementation; tool or implementation gaps are never permanent unsupported judgments.

native_check: profile, project boundary, and copied fixture only
skills.limitation: No Ruby adapter artifact or explicit plain-Ruby/gem/framework selection outcome is validated.
No final audit associates decision comments with reopened or dynamically defined behavior.

native_check: Ruby syntax and explicit require_relative fixture only
skills.limitation: Dynamic dispatch, constant lookup, mixins, reopening, callbacks, and runtime metaprogramming lack resolved evidence.
Ruby has multiple enum-like practices and no selected compatibility/type contract reaches the proposal boundary.

native_check: Ruby 3.4 Prism exact comment locations plus ruby -c for every eligible input

positive, clean, decoy, excluded-role, missing/old/failing tool, malformed syntax, stale-artifact, copied-closure, source-preservation, native test, and executable-smoke cases reach the final four artifacts
skills.limitation: One bounded adjacent percentage-comment versus fixed-return rule; reopening, metaprogramming, reflection, dynamic loading, Rails, Zeitwerk, and general semantic drift remain explicit non-claims.
Blocks, pattern matching, metaprogramming, generated methods, and DSL counting policy do not reach a final report.
Symbols, strings, aliases, dynamic constants/methods, mixins, and reopened definitions lack identity resolution.

native_check: explicit entrypoints and load edges only
skills.limitation: Reflection, autoload, callbacks, dynamic dispatch, framework loading, and externally invoked APIs hide reachability.
No accepted normalization handles blocks, heredocs, DSLs, monkey patches, or metaprogramming through final triage.

native_check: plain gem layout and source roles only
skills.limitation: Bundler gem layout does not imply Rails/Zeitwerk, Rack, native-extension, monorepo, or application topology.
Globals, class variables, constants, memoization, callbacks, monkey patches, reopening, and runtime DSL state are unresolved.
Resolved call/constant targets, autoload roots, runtime variants, and trajectory evidence are unavailable.
Syntax size cannot prove runtime responsibilities introduced by mixins, reopenings, DSLs, or generated methods.
Duck typing, delegation, runtime patching, blocks, and dynamic dispatch prevent equivalence claims from syntax alone.
Compiler/lock success is not a standards-gap artifact; RuboCop, Standard Ruby, Steep, or Sorbet must be project-owned and configured.

native_check: frozen partial explicit-load contract with native test/smoke obligations
skills.limitation: No durable map artifact exists; base facts must remain partial without a compatible project-owned analyzer.

native_check: mutation intentionally not performed; frozen positive/refusal/native contract only
skills.limitation: Static lineage, exact edits, rollback, stale clearing, and all native verification remain unproved.
No producer-to-project-owned Ruby guard reaches pre/post native verification.
No resolved dependency graph covers mixins, dynamic constants/calls, callbacks, autoload, or framework wiring.
Ruby gem, app, Rails/Zeitwerk, native-extension, and monorepo layouts require separate conventions and semantic evidence.
Symbols, strings, send/const_get, aliases, DSLs, reflection, reopening, and framework conventions evade syntax-only rename.
Aliases, refinements, reopenings, delegation, duck typing, callbacks, and runtime compatibility lack equivalence evidence.
